text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*yaaaawn*... Mmm, I really should get 
to sleep soon... but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Wasn't there someone saying she felt 
lonely because no one else watched 
late-night anime live... and that she 
wanted to hear people's thoughts...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Will I still understand what's going on 
if I start watching midway through? Where 
are my headphones... I have to be careful 
not to wake Mirako-senpai...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. If I recall, someone also wanted my 
thoughts on the foreign drama airing after 
the anime... Oh, and the movie airing 
right after that, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Flame ended up staying up late into 
the night just to share her thoughts with 
her friend.
